_doc: Chromium-family browsers Playwright can drive with the user's real profile. Paths use ~ for home. Edit here, not in code.

chromium.list:
tell application "{app}"
set out to ""
set wi to 0
repeat with w in windows
set wi to wi + 1
set ti to 0
repeat with t in tabs of w
set ti to ti + 1
set out to out & wi & "|" & ti & "|" & (URL of t) & linefeed
end repeat
end repeat
return out
end tell
chromium.activate:
tell application "{app}"
set active tab index of window {w} to {t}
set index of window {w} to 1
activate
end tell

safari.list:
tell application "{app}"
set out to ""
set wi to 0
repeat with w in windows
set wi to wi + 1
set ti to 0
repeat with t in tabs of w
set ti to ti + 1
set out to out & wi & "|" & ti & "|" & (URL of t) & linefeed
end repeat
end repeat
return out
end tell
safari.activate:
tell application "{app}"
set current tab of window {w} to tab {t} of window {w}
set index of window {w} to 1
activate
end tell
